RESEND_API_KEY.description: Resend API key with **Sending access**. Use a placeholder now and change it later. See [the setup guide](https://github.com/me-shaon/plainbooks/blob/main/docs/setup.md#10-set-up-resend).

RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Signing secret of the Resend webhook. It starts with `whsec_`. Use a placeholder now and change it later.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Zero Trust team domain, for example `your-team.cloudflareaccess.com`. Use a placeholder now and change it later.

ACCESS_AUD.description: The **Application Audience (AUD) Tag** of the Access application for the whole app. Use a placeholder now and change it later.

OWNER_EMAIL.description: Email of the first Owner, in lowercase.

APP_URL.description: Public origin of the app, for example `https://invoices.example.com`. No trailing slash.

scripts.e2e:db: rm -rf .wrangler/e2e && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
